chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Jamilah, from Aban ibn Taghlib, that Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, said:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, learnt that a group among the Quraysh was saying: "Does Muhammad think that he has secured this matter (of succession) among his Ahl al-Bayt? If he dies, we shall certainly remove it from them and place it among others."

So the Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, went out until he stood in their gathering, then said: "O people of Quraysh, how will it be with you when you have disbelieved after me, and then you see me with a battalion of my companions striking your faces and necks with the sword?"

Then Jibra'il, peace be upon him, descended at that moment and said: "O Muhammad! Indeed your Lord sends you greetings of peace and says to you: Say, 'Allah willing, [or] and Ali ibn Abi Talib.'" The Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, then said: "Allah willing, [or] and Ali ibn Abi Talib will take charge of that among you."

key_terms.أهل بيته: Ahl al-Bayt - the household of the Prophet, specifically referring to his family who were designated for leadership
key_terms.الأمر: The matter - refers here to the leadership/succession (khilafa) after the Prophet
key_terms.كفرتم: You have disbelieved/disobeyed - indicates grave rejection of divine authority
key_terms.يتولى: Will take charge of/handle - indicates assumption of authority and responsibility

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to the Quraysh about the succession of Ali ibn Abi Talib?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an incident where the Prophet (SAWW) confronted the Quraysh who were plotting to transfer the matter of succession away from Ahl al-Bayt after his death. He warned them sternly of the consequences of such disobedience. Angel Jibra'il then descended with a divine command directing the Prophet to declare that Ali ibn Abi Talib would be the one to handle this matter, affirming the divinely ordained succession through the Prophet's household.
